Type | Zoning Narrative for
2653-2657 S. Kildare Avenue; 4246-4258 W. 27th Street
C3-3 to C3-3

A. The applicant proposes to rezone the subject property from C3-3 Commercial,
Manufacturing and Employment District to C3-3 Commercial, Manufacturing and
Employment District. to construct a new 5-story building with 10 parking spaces and to
establish a community center use. The applicant will seek a special use for the
community center subsequent to a successful rezoning. Applicant to seek all zoning
relief as needed, as allowed by the Chicago Zoning Code, for the attached plans.

The subject property is a Transit Serviced Location based on proximity to 26" Street
(approximately 560 feet).

The applicant is seeking the following relief: (i) as per Type I Section 17-13-0303-D, an
adjustment to reduce the number of bicycle parking spaces from 48 spaces to 24 spaces
in accordance with Section 17-13-1003-GG, and (ii) as per Section 17-3-0408-B(1), an
increase in maximum building height for projects in the C3 district that are within 1,320
feet of a CTA bus line corridor.
